# ContainerPaginationExtensions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Fluent forms of the pagination control primitives.

Namespace `BonniePDF.Fluent`.

## Methods

- [`EnsureSpace`](#ensurespace): Starts a new page unless at least `minHeight` points of body height remain.
- [`PreventPageBreak`](#preventpagebreak): Keeps the wrapped content together, moving it whole to the next page rather than splitting it across the boundary.
- [`ShowEntire`](#showentire): Renders the wrapped content only where it fits whole, never splitting it.
- [`ShowIf`](#showif): Renders the wrapped content only on the pages `predicate` accepts.
- [`ShowOnce`](#showonce): Renders the wrapped content on the document's first page only.
- [`SkipOnce`](#skiponce): Renders the wrapped content on every page except the first.
- [`StopPaging`](#stoppaging): Renders what fits on the current page and discards the rest, instead of continuing onto further pages.
- [`Unconstrained`](#unconstrained): Renders the wrapped content outside the flow: it draws from the current position but consumes no height, so following content overlaps it.

### `EnsureSpace`

```csharp
IContentContainer EnsureSpace(IContentContainer c, float minHeight)
```

*static*

Starts a new page unless at least `minHeight` points of body height remain. The orphaned-heading control.

### `PreventPageBreak`

```csharp
IContentContainer PreventPageBreak(IContentContainer c)
```

*static*

Keeps the wrapped content together, moving it whole to the next page rather than splitting it across the boundary.

### `ShowEntire`

```csharp
IContentContainer ShowEntire(IContentContainer c)
```

*static*

Renders the wrapped content only where it fits whole, never splitting it. Content taller than a page is cut off rather than continued.

### `ShowIf`

```csharp
IContentContainer ShowIf(IContentContainer c, Func<PageContext, bool> predicate)
```

*static*

Renders the wrapped content only on the pages `predicate` accepts.

### `SkipOnce`

```csharp
IContentContainer SkipOnce(IContentContainer c)
```

### `StopPaging`

```csharp
IContentContainer StopPaging(IContentContainer c)
```

*static*

Renders what fits on the current page and discards the rest, instead of continuing onto further pages.

### `Unconstrained`

```csharp
IContentContainer Unconstrained(IContentContainer c)
```

*static*

Renders the wrapped content outside the flow: it draws from the current position but consumes no height, so following content overlaps it.
